description: Write the next message on older accepted threads only. Use when you already have the thread key for an older accepted thread and need to send the next line. Do not use this for a first reply — use write_first_reply. No new threads. The thread key is sent in the JSON body, not in the path.

text.description: Message text. Empty notes and notes over 500 characters are dropped.

thread_key.description: Thread key. Sent in the JSON body.
